subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the third number is related to the fourth number.

144 ∶ 225 ∶∶ 169 ∶ 256 ∶∶ ? ∶ 361
solution:
**The logic followed here is : (Square root of 1st number) = (square root of 2nd number - 3)**

 
• 144 ∶ 225

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca3daf797fe361da576171967c39e1b70d1c54da9cf5a9bc0c21d872371650a7.png] ​

 
• 169 : 256

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eae8049ba9a49fb230852d4eb35d1ff224c7a2135081ee8512230bf9e7aa7f5.png] 

​Similarly, 

 
• ? ∶ 361

​361 is square of 19, so first number will be = (19 - 3) ⇒ 16

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6e8aa4e324f509c1ec1cb779e31dadf8f5b9c23d05bfd5b8c09e21a788b6132.png] 

Hence, **"256"** is the correct answer.
